- Tuesday: 13:00-13:30 or 13:30-14:00, or 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-15:30 or 15:30-16:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these slots and let me know which ones work for both of them. I'll create the booking once we find a time that works for all four partners.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Monday 09:30-10:00: Both are busy.
- Tuesday 13:00-13:30: Both are busy.
- Tuesday 13:30-14:00: Both are busy.
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both are busy.
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30: Elena is free, but David is busy (Partner lunch).
- Wednesday 15:30-16:00: Both are busy.
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy (Hiring panel).
- Friday 11:00-11:30: Both are busy.
- Friday 11:30-12:00: Both are busy.

None of the slots where Priya and Marcus are free also work for Elena and David. It appears there is no 30-minute window next week where all four partners are available. We may need to report this as infeasible or flag for human intervention.
